summary: Tested Admin Role Selection Feature for assigning base role and custom role to users. All backend APIs (create, update, clear custom_role) work correctly. Frontend UI has proper dropdowns for Base Role and Custom Role with all 7 custom roles available. User creation via UI successfully persists custom_role to database.

issues: Dialog shows helpful message 'User will have permissions from both X role and Y role' which is good UX

seed_data_creation: Test users created during testing were cleaned up automatically via pytest fixtures and manual cleanup
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin Role Selection feature fully tested. Backend endpoints POST /api/admin/users and PUT /api/admin/users/{user_id} both support custom_role field. Frontend AdminDashboard.jsx UsersTab has both base role and custom role dropdowns with data-testid attributes for easy testing.

get_available_custom_roles.details: Returns 7 custom roles: admin, finance_admin, regional_manager, sales_manager, super_admin, supervisor, support_agent

create_user_with_custom_role.details: User created with base_role='buyer' and custom_role='sales_manager' persisted correctly

update_user_custom_role.details: custom_role can be updated from 'sales_manager' to 'regional_manager'

clear_custom_role.details: Setting custom_role to empty string clears it

frontend_add_user_dialog.details: Add New User dialog has Base Role dropdown (Buyer/Vendor/Admin) and Custom Role dropdown with all 7 roles + None option

frontend_edit_user_dialog.details: Edit User dialog also has both Base Role and Custom Role dropdowns with data-testid attributes

frontend_custom_role_persistence.details: User created via UI with Sales Manager custom role was verified in database
